items.markdown:
Thailand's Long-Term Resident (LTR) visa is `a 10-year residency program for wealthy global citizens, wealthy pensioners, remote workers, and skilled experts` . It costs 50,000 Thai Baht (about $1,500 USD) and applications are submitted online through the [Thailand Board of Investment](https://ltr.boi.go.th/).[[1]](https://www.hlbthai.com/thailand-long-term-resident-ltr-visa/)[[2]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/long-term-resident-visa)

Visa Categories and Rules

- **Wealthy Global Citizens:** Must hold at least $1 million USD in total assets, including specific investments in Thailand.[](https://www.hlbthai.com/thailand-long-term-resident-ltr-visa/) 
- **Wealthy Pensioners:** Must be 50 or older with an annual passive income of at least $80,000 USD, or $40,000 USD if they invest $250,000 USD in Thai assets.[](https://www.hlbthai.com/thailand-long-term-resident-ltr-visa/) 
- **Work-from-Thailand Professionals:** Must earn at least $80,000 USD per year for the past two years working for established overseas companies.[](https://www.hlbthai.com/thailand-long-term-resident-ltr-visa/) 
- **Highly-Skilled Professionals:** Must work in target industries or specialized fields in Thailand with a qualifying salary.[](https://www.hlbthai.com/thailand-long-term-resident-ltr-visa/) 

Key Benefits

- **10-Year Stay:** Granted as a 5-year visa that can be renewed for another 5 years.[](https://www.hlbthai.com/thailand-long-term-resident-ltr-visa/) 
- **Tax Perks:** Foreign-sourced income is tax-exempt for most categories, while highly skilled workers get a flat 17% tax rate on local work income.[](https://www.hlbthai.com/thailand-long-term-resident-ltr-visa/) 
- **Easy Reporting:** Annual check-ins instead of the standard 90-day reporting.[](https://www.hlbthai.com/thailand-long-term-resident-ltr-visa/) 
- **Work Freedom:** Includes permission to work or a digital work permit, and drops the rule to hire four Thai local workers for every foreign employee.[](https://www.hlbthai.com/thailand-long-term-resident-ltr-visa/) 

If you'd like, tell me which **category** you might fit into, and I can help outline the exact paperwork you will need to apply.
